decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's engineering and waste-to-energy direction, and there is no evidence after 2019 that it met aspirations, so problemistic search would likely send its resources to the core technology ventures.
The modular plant extensions support the firm's waste-to-energy offering and need little extra slack, though their low visibility, only ever mentioned, makes their performance uncertain.

WASTX Oil is a flagship with its own page and a press launch, and fits the firm's strategic direction, so management will likely keep carrying it despite uncertain results while the firm is growing and hiring.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship that was given more prominence in 2019, and it matches the firm's long-term vision, so a drop is unlikely unless results fall clearly short.
